featured_reviews.review_text: The owner seems to be an irrate & a frustrated man. Today I purchased a expensive pouch worth Rs 370 & paid for it. I wanted to purchase more. I happened to go else where & come back to Ato Z stationary, as my daughter already knew what to purchase. The owner rudely said that I was wasting time taking into consideration that I had already purchase a pouch from his just a few minutes back. When I requested to show the variety of pouches again. He again said its not abt telling somebody  to help me but I was again just wasting time. I told him what must be done. Can I just leave ? He said its ur wish to leave, rather than helping me with my purchase. I then told him to cancel my first purchase. He rudely said we cannot do that and he does not exchange. After an argument he finally showed me the products (pouches) again and finally I ended up making another expensive purchase of Rs 400 approx. I want to highlight to buyers  that, this conversation can be avoided & that the buyer is racist, rude, has attitude issues. Not helpful and just disrespectful person, I assume towards certain customers only. Please Note its not me but me and my 6 year old daughter were insulted  by the owner. I shall file for consumers regarding this owner for arrogance, attitude + old and damaged stock.

featured_reviews.review_text:
I had an excellent experience at this stationery store and would highly recommend it to anyone looking for quality products and reliable service. The shop offers a wide range of stationery items, covering everything from basic office supplies to more specialized materials. All products are well-organized, easily accessible, and of very good quality.
What truly stands out is the professionalism and helpful nature of the staff. Every team member is polite, attentive, and genuinely willing to assist customers with their requirements. They guide you patiently, suggest suitable options, and ensure that you find exactly what you need without any hassle.
The pricing is also very reasonable compared to the quality provided, which makes it even more value for money. Despite being a busy store, the service is quick, efficient, and well-managed. I never felt rushed or ignored, which reflects their commitment to customer satisfaction.
Overall, this is a highly reliable and customer-friendly stationery store. Whether you need items for office, school, or personal use, this place has everything you need under one roof. I will definitely continue visiting and would strongly recommend it to others.
